btn.how_create_text: Click Add Command Button, give it a name, and enter the shell command you want to run — for example sudo systemctl restart apache2 or sudo reboot. Choose an icon, colour, and size.

rpi.boot_warning: These files control how the Raspberry Pi boots. A wrong value in config.txt or cmdline.txt can make the Pi fail to boot or lose network/SSH access — which may require pulling the SD card and editing it on another computer to recover. A backup (.piweb.bak) is written before every save, but only edit these if you know what each line does.
